facts.text: The published expert recommendation is to set commanded deceleration for each machine at each moment to a_command = min(a_collision-need, a_traction, a_stability, a_machine, a_load/attachment).
facts.quote: a_command = min(a_collision-need, a_traction, a_stability, a_machine, a_load/attachment)

facts.text: In the recommended commanded-deceleration calculation, a_collision-need is the deceleration required to preserve the target clearance.
facts.quote: a_collision-need is the deceleration required to preserve the target clearance

facts.text: In the recommended commanded-deceleration calculation, the traction limit is a_traction = µ_min·g·cos θ − g·sin θ, based on the current surface and tire or track capability.
facts.quote: a_traction = µ_min·g·cos θ − g·sin θ from the current surface and tire or track capability

facts.text: In the recommended commanded-deceleration calculation, a_stability comes from multibody analysis of roll, pitch, yaw and articulation state, including payload.
facts.quote: a_stability comes from the roll, pitch, yaw and articulation state, with payload, from the multibody analysis

facts.text: In the recommended commanded-deceleration calculation, a_machine is determined by actual brake and drive capability and thermal state.
facts.quote: a_machine from actual brake and drive capability and thermal state

facts.text: In the recommended commanded-deceleration calculation, a_load/attachment is determined by payload-shift or implement constraints, with an operator-restraint limit alongside.
facts.quote: a_load/attachment from payload-shift or implement constraints, with an operator-restraint limit alongside

facts.text: The published expert recommendation is to ramp machine deceleration up gradually using a jerk limit.
facts.quote: Ramp the deceleration up gradually (a jerk limit)

facts.text: The published expert recommendation is never to release the machine brake on a downgrade.
facts.quote: never release the brake on a downgrade

facts.text: The published expert recommendation is to finish machine braking in a parking-brake or hold state so the machine cannot roll away.
facts.quote: finish in a parking-brake or hold state so the machine cannot roll away

facts.text: When the deceleration needed to avoid a collision exceeds the safe envelope, the published expert recommendation is still to apply the maximum safe mitigation.
facts.quote: when the deceleration needed to avoid the collision exceeds the safe envelope, still apply the maximum safe mitigation

facts.text: When the deceleration needed to avoid a collision exceeds the safe envelope, the published expert recommendation is to report that avoidance is no longer physically guaranteed rather than silently assuming commanded deceleration will be achieved.
facts.quote: report that avoidance is no longer physically guaranteed rather than silently assuming the commanded deceleration will be achieved
